mostWorthwhile.text: The quiet moment in the receiving laboratory was the most worthwhile passage: the folded limbs finally reach another pair of hands, without forcing an explanation.

leastWorthwhile.text: The arrival board after the ending felt unnecessary, since there were no goals or actions left.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the story ended with silence in the laboratory rather than an explanation of the specimen.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to judge.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to learn what the laboratory discovers, although this chapter offered no decisions to play.
